$comment: Provider-neutral session defaults. Providers map these onto their own wire format; see core/schema/agent-bundle.schema.json and docs/providers.md.

turnDetection.$comment: Riff should not interrupt someone who is mid-thought. Semantic endpointing with low eagerness waits for a real end of turn instead of a pause.

transcription.$comment: Verbatim user speech is the source of truth for the prompt body, so transcription quality is load bearing. Vocabulary biasing is compiled from the active lexicon at connect time.
